# VSCO Community Edition percussion

Three short hits, copied unmodified from [sgossner/VSCO-2-CE](https://github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE) (master):

- `claves_pp1.wav` from `VSCO 1 Percussion/varWood/claves_pp1.wav`
- `snare_pp2.wav` from `VSCO 1 Percussion/drums/snare/OldSnare/snare_pp2.wav`
- `shake8.wav` from `VSCO 1 Percussion/varWood/Camo's Shaker/shake8.wav`

License: CC0 1.0 Universal (`LICENSE` in this directory, the upstream LICENSE file).
Upstream statement: <https://versilian-studios.com/vsco-community/>

The rest of the library is not vendored. The lab's oscillators are original and remain the score. These hits are a quiet layer, fetched after the listener turns sound on.
